args.body: Hi Dora, I visited www.dora-website.com. The personal introduction and email address make it clear whose site it is and how to contact you. The content available to me was very brief; adding a short bio, examples of your work or interests, and what visitors can expect would help them get to know you better. I could only assess the text provided, not the visual design.

Hi Eve, I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a potential focus. The content available to me was very brief; adding a welcoming introduction and some hiking posts—such as favorite trails, trip stories, or practical tips—would give visitors more to explore. I could only assess the text provided, not the visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email on her site, and sent feedback to Dora and Eve.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a bio and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested adding a welcoming introduction and hiking stories or tips.

The feedback was based on the available text, not the sites’ visual design.
